news.headline: Evvy raises $40M as it seeks to further women’s health research with vaginal microbiome data
news.summary: Evvy, a women's health startup focused on vaginal microbiome research, just closed a $40M Series B to expand its data platform and accelerate clinical studies. The round, led by Catalio Capital Management, signals growing investor interest in closing the gap in women-specific health research.

news.headline: US Seeks Forfeiture of $61 Million in Crypto Linked to Alleged Iranian Oil Scheme
news.summary: US authorities are moving to seize $61 million in cryptocurrency allegedly tied to an Iranian oil scheme. Prosecutors say two Chinese companies used Binance accounts to launder proceeds that benefited Iran's government and military operations.

educational.title: What Actually Happens When You Buy a Stock
points: You're buying a tiny slice of real ownership in a company, not a lottery ticket
Your broker matches your order with a seller through an exchange in milliseconds
Stock price moves on collective belief about future profits, not just today's news
You make money two ways: the price rising, or dividends paid out over time
Owning one share still makes you a part-owner, with voting rights and all
